const long long MOD = 1000000007;

    long long A[31][31];
    int N;
    
    Matrix operator *(const Matrix &B)const{
        Matrix C; C.N = N; 
        for(int i = 0 ; i <= N ; ++i){
            for(int j = 0 ; j <= N ; ++j){
                C.A[i][j] = 0;
                for(int k = 0 ; k <= N ; ++k){
                    C.A[i][j] = (C.A[i][j] + A[i][k]*B.A[k][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        return C;
    }
}A[64][30],sum[64][30],suf[64][30],ans;

LL N,K,dig[70],cnt;

    scanf("%lld%lld",&N,&K);
    while(N){dig[cnt++] = N % K; N /= K;}
    for(int i = 0 ; i < K ; ++i){
        for(int j = 0 ; j <= K ; ++j){
            A[0][i].A[j][j] = 1;
            A[0][i].A[j][i] = 1;
        }
        A[0][i].N = K;
    }
    sum[0][0] = A[0][0]; suf[0][K-1] = A[0][K-1];
    for(int i = 1 ; i < K ; ++i) sum[0][i] = sum[0][i-1]*A[0][i];
    for(int i = K - 2; i >= 0 ; --i) suf[0][i] = A[0][i]*suf[0][i+1];
    for(int i = 1 ; i < cnt ; ++i){
        A[i][0] = suf[i-1][0];
        for(int j = 1 ; j < K ; ++j)
            A[i][j] = suf[i-1][j]*sum[i-1][j-1];
        sum[i][0] = A[i][0]; suf[i][K-1] = A[i][K-1];
        for(int j = 1 ; j < K ; ++j) sum[i][j] = sum[i][j-1]*A[i][j];
        for(int j = K - 2 ; j >= 0; --j) suf[i][j] = A[i][j]*suf[i][j+1];
    }
    ans.A[0][K] = 1; ans.N = K;
    ans = ans*sum[cnt-1][dig[cnt-1] - 1];
    int last = dig[cnt-1];
    for(int i = cnt - 2 ; i >= 0 ; --i){
        for(int j = 0 ; j < dig[i] ; ++j)    
            ans = ans*A[i][(j+last)%K];
